messages:
deploybot: Rollout r-2026-03-21-51 started in eu-west1 at 14:20 UTC. Detected elevated 502s and latency; automatic pause triggered at 14:23 UTC.
alex: seeing repeated redis timeouts in canary logs, kvcache evictions spike. stack traces attached.
maria: p95 latency ~750ms on canaries, errors concentrated on model-serving nodes. Not safe to proceed.
sam: recommend quarantining the rollout and pinning traffic back to v1.4.2 until we validate. Avoid a full rollback for now.
priya: +1 quarantine. Two quick options: pin traffic and run a targeted smoke, or reduce canary weight to 1% and disable batching. Which is faster?
luis: I'll take ops steps. Pin to v1.4.2 and run smoke once Alex confirms.
alex: running commands: `/deploybot pause r-2026-03-21-51` then `/deploybot pin r-2026-03-21-51 v1.4.2` — confirmed paused and pinned at 14:26 UTC.
release-conductor: Note: next change window is 03:00 UTC tomorrow. If smoke passes we can requeue for that window. If not, schedule deeper RCA.
maria: filed ticket RED-3129 with initial findings and added release note: rollout quarantined due to kvcache/redis errors. link: https://go/issues/RED-3129
sam: plan in ticket: disable auto-batching, add kvcache debug, smaller batch size, run smoke script. Smoke scheduled 02:40 UTC.
priya: I'll open a quick PR to add fallback rule: if kvcache eviction rate >20% for 5m, auto-fallback to pinned version.
luis: monitoring ops now. Will post metrics during smoke.
alex: leave pinned state documented at https://go/releases/r-2026-03-21-51.
maria: notified product and support. :memo:
deploybot: Reminder: pinned rollouts remain pinned until manually unpinned or unpaused by an authorized user.
release-conductor: Summarizing owners: Luis (ops), Alex (deploy), Sam (rerun), Maria (ticket/notes), Priya (policy). ETA initial findings +2h. Updates will be appended to RED-3129.
